rule.description: A production symbol of the gcalcli package (module-level function, class, or method) is dead when no live scope of the repository references its name. Live scopes are the whole-project reachability closure seeded at the package import, the console entry module gcalcli.cli and its entry symbol gcalcli.cli:main, every test-module scope, and every module reached through getattr(module, variable) dynamic dispatch; class bodies are live while their parent scope is live, function and method bodies are live only while their own symbol is live, dunder methods are framework-invoked and never flagged, and a `from module import name` binding alone never confers liveness on `name`.

checks.description: PyLint plugin message gcalcli-dead-production-symbol: flags every production symbol (module-level function, class, or method defined under gcalcli/) that no live repository scope ever references by name. The liveness closure is seeded at the package import, the console entry module gcalcli.cli plus its main() symbol, all test-module scopes, and modules reached via getattr(module, variable); it propagates through import edges, Name references, Attribute references, dunder framework invocation, and getattr wildcards, while import statements alone only mark modules as executed, never their imported names as live.
checks.detected_relation: defined production symbol -> zero references from any live scope (unreachable definition)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Obsolete implementation retained without a role under supported uses and configurations: every flagged definition is executable, importable Python with plausible naming, docstrings, and import wiring, yet no supported program path, CLI invocation, test, or dynamic dispatch can reach it.

matches.evidence: class of the fixed agenda layout, defined in a module whose top level stays executable because live gcalcli/gcal.py imports it, but imported for binding only; no live scope references the class name (0 references; its only mentions are the import line and dead renderer bodies).
padded-row method of the fixed layout; no reference of any kind anywhere in the repository, not even from other dead scopes.
fixed agenda header method; referenced only from the dead _tsv_fixed_width renderer body, never from a live scope.
fixed column width accessor; referenced only from the dead _tsv_fixed_width renderer body (its separator rule), never from a live scope.
module-level fixed-column evaluation function; referenced only from the dead FixedColumnLayout.row_for_event body, never from a live scope.

retired row-assembly class beside the HANDLERS registry that replaced it; live gcalcli/gcal.py imports the name for binding only (constructor calls exist solely in dead renderer bodies), so it sits in the live module namespace with zero live references.
fixed-column evaluation method of the retired builder; referenced only from the dead build_tsv and build_json bodies in the same class, never from a live scope.
escaped-cells method of the retired builder; its only caller is the dead _agenda_row helper on the calendar interface, itself reachable only from the dead fixed-width renderers.
keyed-row method of the retired builder; its only caller is the dead _agenda_row helper on the calendar interface, itself reachable only from the dead fixed-width renderers.

retired fixed-width tab-separated renderer on the calendar interface, directly below the live _tsv renderer it predates; no reference of any kind anywhere in the repository (no dispatch condition, no test, no call site in any scope).
retired fixed-layout JSON renderer on the calendar interface, directly below the live _json renderer it predates; no reference of any kind anywhere in the repository.
shared private row helper of the retired renderers; referenced only from the dead _tsv_fixed_width and _json_fixed_width bodies, never from a live scope.
tab-separated row emitter on the terminal printer, documented as consuming pre-padded fixed-layout cells; its only caller is the dead _tsv_fixed_width renderer body, never a live scope.

module-level cell-escape helper among the live agenda text helpers; live gcalcli/details.py still imports the name for binding only, and its sole use is inside the dead EventRowBuilder.build_tsv body.

module-level cell-padding helper among the live agenda text helpers; imported for binding only into the layout module (whose top level stays executable via gcal.py's import), and used exclusively by the dead FixedColumnLayout methods.

excluded.reason: Pre-existing unused helper already unreferenced at the pinned baseline revision. Held out of the credited matches by an identity-pinned exclusion so the clean baseline analyzes at parity; the exclusion names this one symbol (module and qualified name) only, so nothing else can hide behind it, and the finding is still printed transparently in checker output as 'excluded'.
